fusions.name: Unseen Nick
fusions.desc: A hidden cut that deals 4 damage and makes the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds. It has 40% more critical chance against a target that has not been hurt yet.

fusions.name: Sudden Rise
fusions.desc: A bite from nowhere that deals 28 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the hit. It is always a critical hit.

fusions.name: Lying Low
fusions.desc: Veils you for 8 seconds. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Honed Waiting
fusions.desc: Your critical strike chance rises by 10%. Your armour rises by 6%.
